Enjoy outdoor relaxation on the shared front balcony. Residents enjoy access to excellent recreational amenities including tennis courts & sparkling pool. Special roof assessment of $84.51/month through June 30, 2027.  Bonus for buyers: The owner is willing to fully pay out the upcoming roof special assessment w/an acceptable offer, offering you immediate peace of mind!
